cohort: Women who had a vaginal birth after cesarean section (VBAC) between 2012 and 2016 at two hospitals in the Czech Republic.
finding: While the rate of levator avulsion was higher in the elective cesarean section group, the difference was not statistically significant.
mod_finding: VBAC is associated with a significantly higher rate of levator ani avulsion compared to the first vaginal birth in nulliparous women.
